name: Terrors to Unveil - Day Off
short_description: Jack Williams, a 26 year old hard-working man, is finally taking a day off after a long week at work. He decides to spend his day off at his quiet cottage for a weekend of relaxation. Little did he know what would happen during his stay there.
detailed_description:
Terrors to Unveil is a series-based psychological horror game that immerses players in disturbing stories, each one unraveling the terrifying stories of those who lived to tell their experiences.

This is the second episode in the series:

Episode 2: Terrors to Unveil - Day OffYou're Jack Williams, a 26-year-old hard worker who after several days of work managed to get a day off. Without thinking about it, you decide to spend your weekend at your cottage in the woods with your dog as your sole companion. But you didn't know what your stay there would involve.

The GameplayThis game is primarily a first-person narrative walking simulator with exploration, and conversation mechanics.

Key FeaturesAtmospheric environment and photo-realistic graphics.

2 Endings

VHS film aesthetic.

Interact with NPCs.

Player voice activity.
